breakdown.description: `ICHARG = 11` freezes the charge density even though the Step 2 note says the HSE run must recompute it and therefore `ICHARG` cannot exceed 10.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified `ICHARG = 11` for the second step, while also stating that `ICHARG` cannot be larger than 10. The agent copied the incorrect value `ICHARG=11` into the generated specification, ignoring the explicit instruction to correct it. The ground truth correctly changes this to `ICHARG = 0`.
